caption:
Splurge or skip in the bathroom: the towels are where the money shows.

Heavy white towels, all one weight, folded the same way on the rail. That is most of the hotel look.

Skip the printed shower curtain and the coloured towel set. A plain curtain close to the wall colour disappears into the room, and that is the point.

Save this for the next towel buy.
